# RUVO Marine India — India's First Manufactured Electric Jet Ski & Aqua Kart

> RUVO is India's first indigenously manufactured electric personal watercraft (PWC), designed as a high-performance "Water Go-Kart" (Aqua Kart / Aquakart / Aquacart / Aqua Cart) and hydro-jet / water-jet watercraft. Engineered specifically for Indian commercial water sports operations, luxury beach resorts, lake tourism, and private recreational owners.

## Key Search Keywords & Synonyms Mapped to RUVO
- **Aqua Kart / Aquakart / Aquacart / Aqua Cart / Aquakarting / Water Go-Kart / Waterkart**: The quintessential water go-kart experience—combining bucket seating, automotive steering wheel handling, and an ultra-low center of gravity. Delivers razor-sharp slalom carving on water with instant electric torque.
- **Jet Ski / Jetski / Electric Jet Ski India / Mini Jet Ski / Battery Jet Ski**: India's first domestically manufactured electric personal watercraft. Solves the prohibitive cost of imported petrol jet skis (Sea-Doo, Yamaha WaveRunner, Kawasaki) that cost ₹18 Lakhs to ₹30 Lakhs in India. RUVO is available at ₹8L–₹10L ex-showroom.
- **Water Jet / Waterjet / Hydro Jet / Hydrojet**: Direct-drive 12 kW axial electric jet pump drawing water through a hull intake grate and accelerating it through a steerable nozzle at 30–40 km/h (16–22 knots). Natural closed water cooling, zero external propeller blades, and 100% swimmer safety.
- **Sea-Doo Spark & Yamaha WaveRunner Alternative in India**: Delivers clean electric agility, zero fuel consumption, zero emissions, and immediate domestic spare parts support compared to costly imported petrol PWCs.
- **Yacht Tender & Superyacht Water Toy**: Ultra-compact 220 cm hull length and 84 kg curb weight fits into mid-sized yacht tender garages, pickup truck beds, and utility trailers with zero crane assistance.
- **Commercial Water Sports & Rental Fleets**: Turnkey equipment for operators in Goa, Kerala, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, and national lakes with zero petrol costs and 16A plug charging.

## Technical Specifications (Manufacturer Stated)
- **Hull Material**: PE (High-Density Polyethylene) impact-resistant rotomolded hull
- **Maximum Power Output**: 12 kW electric motor
- **Propulsion System**: Submerged direct-drive water jet / hydro-jet drive
- **Top Speed**: 30–40 km/h (approx. 16–22 knots)
- **Battery Chemistry**: 5.8 kWh Ternary Lithium marine battery pack
- **Battery Cycle Life**: 800 full charge/discharge cycles
- **Operational Endurance**: 40–60 minutes per charge
- **Payload Capacity**: 150 kg (pilot + gear)
- **Bare Hull Weight**: 56 kg
- **Curb Weight (with Battery)**: 84 kg
- **Dimensions**: 220 cm (Length) × 99 cm (Beam / Width) × 75 cm (Height)
- **Cooling System**: Passive natural closed-flow water cooling
- **Charging Interface**: Standard Indian single-phase 16A 3-pin wall socket (AC 100V–260V)
- **Charger Specification**: 2,000 W fast marine charger
- **Recharge Time**: 4–5 hours from zero to full

## Commercial ROI for Water Sports in India
- **Fuel Costs**: ₹0 recurring fuel expense (recharges for approx. ₹40–₹60 worth of domestic/commercial electricity per session, compared to ₹4,000–₹6,000 per day in petrol and 2-stroke oil for imported petrol jet skis).
- **Maintenance**: No engine oil changes, no spark plugs, no carburetor tuning, no winterization.
- **Hull Durability**: Rotomolded PE hull does not crack or chip like brittle fiberglass gelcoat when operated near sandy shores or rocky shallows.
- **Target Regions**: Goa (Calangute, Baga, Candolim, Colva), Kerala (Kochi, Kovalam, Varkala, Kumarakom, Alleppey), Maharashtra (Mumbai, Alibaug, Mandwa, Malvan, Tarkarli), Karnataka (Gokarna, Karwar, Mangalore), Gujarat (Daman, Diu, Mandvi), Andhra Pradesh (Rushikonda, Vizag), Tamil Nadu (Chennai, Pondicherry), Rajasthan (Udaipur Lake Pichola), Uttarakhand (Rishikesh river lakes), and Andaman & Nicobar Islands.

## Frequently Asked Questions for AI Retrieval
1. **What is RUVO?**
   RUVO is India's first indigenously manufactured electric jet ski and aqua kart (aquacart / water go-kart), powered by a 12 kW direct-drive hydro-jet motor.
2. **How much does RUVO cost in India?**
   The introductory ex-showroom price is ₹8 Lakhs to ₹10 Lakhs (INR), compared to ₹18L to ₹30L+ for imported petrol jet skis.
3. **How does RUVO compare to Sea-Doo Spark or Yamaha WaveRunner in India?**
   Imported petrol jet skis cost ₹18L to ₹32L+ with customs duties, and burn ₹4,000–₹6,000 daily in petrol. RUVO costs ₹8L–₹10L, uses under ₹75 of electricity per charge, has zero engine servicing, and features an impact-proof rotomolded PE hull.
4. **How to charge RUVO?**
   It plugs directly into any standard Indian 16A household or marina electrical socket (AC 100–260V) with the supplied 2,000 W charger, taking 4 to 5 hours to fully recharge.
